title: Add deterministic order lifecycle fault fixtures and protocol checks
acceptance_criteria: tests/fixtures/order_events.py provides a scriptable fake Broker port and deterministic event builders using Decimal values, UTC-aware timestamps, stable ids, and a fixed clock with no unseeded randomness
tests/integration/test_order_lifecycle.py contains distinct test cases for scenarios (a) through (j) listed in the description
The ambiguous-submit scenarios assert exactly one submit call, a client_order_id lookup before any retry, and no new client_order_id while unresolved
Duplicate and out-of-order event streams produce a final ledger state identical to the in-order stream
Protective-stop vs exit race scenarios assert that held long quantity never becomes negative and that either the oversell is refused or drift blocks entries
Crash recovery scenarios assert that recovery resolves via lookup and never auto-resubmits an orphaned intent
Replaying the same fixture stream twice produces identical persisted order/ledger projections
Tests use only temporary/in-memory storage and no network access, broker credentials, or live endpoints; no production source files are modified
forbidden_changes: modify any production module under mike_trade/
change PLAN_SKELETON.json or any planning artifacts
use broker credentials, network access, or live/paper endpoints
weaken or skip assertions to make tests pass
run broad test suites or backtests
